Verse for AI agents (MCP)#

Early access. The hosted endpoint at /mcp is live (Bearer key required). The @ctruhtech/verse-mcp npm package is prepared and waiting to be published (see docs/handover/mcp-publish.md).

@ctruhtech/verse-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server. Add it to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or VS Code and the assistant can take a 3D file (a path on your machine, or a public URL) and hand you back a Verse link that opens in any browser, plus embed code, private links and a guided tour.

It does nothing the REST API cannot: each tool is a thin wrapper over /v1/* through the JS SDK, including the resumable upload for big files.

Install#

Stdio (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code), Node 20+:

Code
{ "mcpServers": { "verse": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@ctruhtech/verse-mcp"], "env": { "VERSE_API_KEY": "your account token" } } } }

Remote (Streamable HTTP) at https://verse.ctruh.com/mcp, with Authorization: Bearer <your key>. Copy-paste setups for each client are in the package README (sdk/mcp/README.md).

Credentials#

VERSE_API_KEY takes your account token (Studio, /studio) or an upload key vk_... (see Authentication). The account token is what owns scenes and unlocks list_scenes, visibility, private links and camera paths. VERSE_BASE_URL points at another origin. The key is sent only to that origin as a header and never logged or returned.

Tools#

ToolREST routes
upload_scenePOST /v1/ingest or the resumable begin / part / commit (from 100 MB, or on request); POST /v1/ingest/url for URLs; polls GET /v1/ingest/<job>
get_scene_statusGET /v1/ingest/<job>, then GET /v1/account/scenes for older scenes
list_scenesGET /v1/account/scenes
create_share_linkPATCH /v1/scenes/<id> (visibility), POST /v1/scenes/<id>/share
revoke_share_linkGET / DELETE /v1/scenes/<id>/share[/<shareId>]
get_embed_codebuilds the iframe / <verse-viewer> from the scene's link
list_camera_paths, set_camera_path, reset_auto_camera_pathGET / POST /v1/scenes/<id>/paths, POST .../paths/auto

Not included, because the API does not offer it: world generation from a prompt or photo, and link expiry (share tokens last until revoked).

Errors are one plain sentence (the server's own friendly error where there is one). Large uploads report progress as MCP progress notifications.

Remote server notes#

The HTTP transport is stateless and bring-your-own-key: each request builds a server bound to the caller's header. Local file paths are refused (a hosted server cannot see your disk); give it a public URL, or use stdio. It is a Node (req, res) handler (createHttpHandler) or verse-mcp --http.

For AI 3D generators#

integrations/ai-generators/ has a tiny JS and Python helper and a "Share as Verse link" button that takes a GLB / PLY / SPZ URL or blob and returns a link and embed code. See its README.
